This page documents the core exported functions of the automated-doc-sync pipeline. Each section describes one exported TypeScript function: its signature, parameters, and purpose.

detectDrift

Detects which exported TypeScript functions have been added or modified compared to the previous commit. Runs git diff GITHUB_SHA^1 GITHUB_SHA via simple-git, compares base and head versions of each changed file using two in-memory ts-morph SourceFile objects, and returns one ExportedFunction entry per changed function.

typescript detectDrift signature ]]>

Parameters

  • changedFilePaths — list of repo-relative file paths that changed in the triggering commit
  • sha — the merge commit SHA (GITHUB_SHA) used to identify base and head versions

compareDrift

Compares a single exported function against its existing documentation section and classifies the relationship as 'current', 'stale', or 'not-found'. The comparison is performed on normalised whitespace so minor formatting differences do not trigger false-positive drift.

typescript compareDrift signature

Returns

  • 'current' — section content matches the canonical rendering of the function
  • 'stale' — section exists but the signature or JSDoc body differs
  • 'not-found' — no matching heading was found in any documentation target

locateMarkdownSection

Locates the documentation section for a given function name by searching every Markdown file that matches the supplied glob pattern. Each file is parsed with remark into an mdast AST and the first ##-level heading whose text exactly matches functionName is treated as the section start.

typescript locateMarkdownSection signature ]]>

redactSecrets

Applies six regex-based redaction patterns to the input string, replacing any matched secret values with the literal string [REDACTED]. Patterns cover GitHub tokens (ghp_, ghs_, github_pat_), Atlassian API tokens, Bearer tokens, and long Base64 blobs. Strings containing no secrets are returned byte-for-byte unchanged.

typescript redactSecrets signature

All output strings written to process.stdout pass through redactSecrets before being emitted, including structured JSON error fields. See architecture §8.5 for the full list of patterns.
